text:
sam: Quick question — we need a new service account for the ingestion pipeline. It will write logs to the console and upload blobs to our object store. What's the minimal set of roles we should grant? also worried about accidental PII in debug logs.

maria: For uploads, you usually just need an object create role (not full admin). For logs, prefer a dedicated logs-write role instead of Project Viewer.

alice: +1. Suggest: `Logs Writer` (ingest only) + `Object Creator` on the target bucket. Avoid any project-wide viewer/read roles. Also create a restricted log sink that strips PII before forwarding.

sam: Got it. Do we have an example redaction rule for the sink? want to avoid shipping raw emails/phone numbers.

alice: Example transform (pseudo):
```
transform: {
  remove_fields: ["user.email","user.phone"],
  replace_patterns: [{field: "message", pattern: "\b\S+@\S+\.\S+\b", with: "[REDACTED_EMAIL]"}]
}
```
That keeps structured fields removed and regex-replaces obvious emails in free text. Not perfect but good default.

security-bot: Policy reminder: see security.redwood.com/logging-redaction for approved sinks and required reviewers. Ephemeral creds strongly recommended for pipeline service accounts.

dana: From approvals side — if you do logs-write + object-creator scoped to specific bucket + a redaction sink, that's inline with least-privilege. For temporary access, we require rotation <= 7 days for non-human creds used by CI. If you need an exception, ping me with justification.

sam: Perfect. I'll set `roles/logs.writer` + `roles/storage.objectCreator` on the bucket, add the sink transform, and request a 7-day rotation policy. I'll drop the IAM binding here when ready for review. Thanks :thumbsup:

maria: small nit — make sure the svc acct has no console login and no broad listPermissions. double-check `list` permissions on buckets are not granted.

sam: Will do. Will ping when it's ready for review.
notes: short async Q&A about least-privilege service account for logs + redaction; includes example transform and policy pointer
